_comment: Display names for TOPP tool parameters, per tool: "<Tool>": {"<parameter path>": "Name"} or {"name": ..., "help": ...}. Parameters without an entry keep the tool's name. See src/workflow/parameter_names.py.

algorithm:common:noise_threshold_int.name: Noise threshold
algorithm:common:noise_threshold_int.help: Intensity below which a peak is treated as noise and not used for mass traces.

algorithm:common:chrom_fwhm.name: Expected peak width (s)
algorithm:common:chrom_fwhm.help: The typical chromatographic peak width at half maximum, in seconds.

algorithm:mtd:mass_error_ppm.name: Mass tolerance (ppm)
algorithm:mtd:mass_error_ppm.help: How far apart in m/z, in ppm, the peaks of one mass trace may be.

FeatureFinderMetabo.algorithm:ffm:remove_single_traces: Remove features with a single trace

algorithm:link:rt_tol.name: Retention time tolerance (s)
algorithm:link:rt_tol.help: How far apart in retention time, in seconds, features of different runs may be and still be linked.

algorithm:link:mz_tol.name: m/z tolerance
algorithm:link:mz_tol.help: How far apart in m/z features of different runs may be and still be linked, in the unit set by m/z unit.
